pages.title: Cabin Mic
pages.text: $(bold)RECORDED AUDIO TRANSCRIPT$()$(br)Recovered from an evac vehicle.$(br)Permission: not required$(br2)VOICE 1: The terminal said report to the field camp. Exact words. Transfer pending, priority red.$(br2)VOICE 2: And Leon stays behind?$(br)VOICE 1: He said the lead meteorologist doesn't get to leave first. Said somebody has to keep the station honest until ORSA finally answers.

pages.title: Last Heard
pages.text: VOICE 3: Weather's dropping again. We should already see the camp by now.$(br2)VOICE 2: If they're really doing transfers, they'll send someone back for him.$(br2)VOICE 1: If they're really doing transfers.$(br2)The recording ends with the vehicle still moving and someone claiming they can almost make out tents through the snow.
